newsitem.title: USA: Kodak to launch marketing push at kids -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Kodak to launch marketing push at kids -WSJ.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co is preparing to launch a marketing and product-promotion campaign aimed at the 33 million U.S. children ages five through 12, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
The newspaper said television commercials aimed at children would begin airing during Saturday morning cartoons during the next few months.
The company plans to sell camera sets, complete with a single use camera and an envelope to mail film back to Kodak for processing, the Journal said.
The campaign would be called "Big Shots," the paper said.
